old_caption: The video captures a dynamic scene of surfing on a lively ocean. The main subject is a surfer dressed in a black wetsuit, skillfully riding a wave. The surfer maneuvers the surfboard with precision, maintaining balance as the wave breaks around them. The ocean's surface is textured with white foam from the breaking waves, indicating the energy and movement of the water. In the background, another person is visible lying on a board. The camera remains static throughout the sequence, focusing on the surfer's actions and the surrounding environment, providing a clear view of the surfing activity.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dynamic scene of surfing on a lively ocean. The main subject is a surfer dressed in a black wetsuit, skillfully riding a wave. The surfer maneuvers the surfboard with precision, maintaining balance as the wave curls around them. The ocean's surface is textured with white foam from the breaking waves, indicating the energy and movement of the water. In the background, other surfers can be seen paddling and waiting for their turn to catch a wave. The sky above is clear, suggesting a sunny day, which enhances the vibrant colors of the scene. The camera remains steady throughout the sequence, focusing on the surfer's actions and the surrounding environment, providing a clear view of the surfing activity and the natural beauty of the ocean.
caption: The video captures a surfer in a dark wetsuit riding a short white surfboard along the shoulder of a breaking wave, a fan-shaped plume of spray rising behind him. He holds a low crouched stance with one arm extended as the board planes roughly horizontal on the water. White foam fills the left of the frame while two other surfers lie prone on their boards in the background. As the ride progresses the board's nose lifts and rotates toward a vertical orientation, the surfer tucking low over the rail. A rounded cloud of spray forms around him, briefly enveloping and obscuring the board during the turn. When the spray subsides the board returns to a horizontal planing position and the surfer resumes a crouched stance with spray kicking up behind. He continues traveling along the wave face toward the right of the frame.
